fresh_validated_observations.topic: Bank of England QT composition produced a high-information sovereign-duration move despite a hawkish short-rate backdrop
fresh_validated_observations.label: DAILY BIG-MOVE CAUSAL LAB / SUPPORTED REGIME-SPECIFIC LEARNING
observed_facts: On Sep.17 the Bank of England held Bank Rate at 3.75% by 6-3; three members preferred a 25 bp hike and the MPC warned that energy-driven inflation risks remained elevated.

The same decision retained £120B of the longest-dated APF gilts to back banknote issuance. The remaining monetary-policy portfolio is to be reduced through maturities plus a much smaller active-sales programme: roughly £222B maturing before 2035 is held to maturity and about £146B of 2035-2049 gilts may be sold at about £20B per year.

Contemporaneous Reuters reporting says active gilt auctions were paused for six months until April and long-dated sales were halted; the Bank/HMT are also considering direct sales to the Debt Management Office.

After the announcement the 30-year gilt yield fell about 12 bp to 5.74%, the 10-year about 8 bp and the 2-year about 6 bp. The 30-year decline was the largest daily fall since May, despite markets still pricing a high probability of a November hike and several hikes through 2027.
The prior 2025-26 QT programme targeted a £70B annual stock reduction and included active sales across maturity buckets, though already with fewer long-maturity sales than short/medium.
fresh_validated_observations.inference: The monetary stance is multidimensional. Removing a price-insensitive expected seller of long-duration bonds can lower the long-end clearing yield/term premium even when the current policy rate is unchanged and expected future policy rates remain hawkish. The curve-specific response (30y rally larger than 10y and 2y) is consistent with a duration-supply channel rather than a simple short-rate-policy channel.
fresh_validated_observations.causal_chain: high long-end yields + expected future APF sales -> BoE announces long-duration retention / six-month sales pause / slower active sales -> expected market-facing duration supply falls -> marginal buyers require less yield to absorb gilts -> long-end yields fall disproportionately -> UK financing conditions ease at the margin even while short-rate expectations remain restrictive
fresh_validated_observations.capital_source_destination: Capital moved toward long-dated gilts / duration exposure while an expected future source of supply from the BoE was removed. Exact account-level buyers remain UNKNOWN; pension/insurer, macro, relative-value and short-cover demand are plausible but not directly identified.
fresh_validated_observations.catalyst: BoE Sep.17 QT implementation redesign and long-dated sale cessation.
fresh_validated_observations.transmission_mechanism: Expected net duration supply and price-insensitive central-bank selling changed independently of the policy-rate path.
amplifiers: Long gilt yields had recently reached multi-decade highs
Thin long-end market depth and convexity
alternative_explanations: The expected Bank Rate hold itself
matched_controls: The rate hold was broadly expected and the inflation guidance was hawkish, yet the long end rallied more than the front end.
The 30y/10y/2y response gradient is directionally consistent with the maturity bucket where expected BoE supply changed most.
The total long-run unwind pace was not wholly surprising; therefore the composition/timing of market-facing supply is the higher-information variable than the headline annual stock reduction alone.
negative_findings: Do not label all QT as one scalar liquidity variable; active sales, passive maturities, duration bucket and buyer capacity differ.
Do not infer a stable basis-point elasticity from this single event.
Do not treat the gilt rally as a clean directional BUY now that the supply surprise has already been repriced and UK inflation/fiscal risks remain material.
fresh_validated_observations.supported_method_rule: For sovereign-duration research, track net duration supply by maturity: fiscal issuance + central-bank active sales - maturities/reinvestment/official absorption, alongside dealer balance-sheet capacity and structural pension/insurer demand. Model this separately from the overnight policy-rate path.
fresh_validated_observations.decision_support: UK long duration: WAIT after the event-driven rally. Research implication is strong; immediate trade edge is not established.
